name: gr1-tabletop-cuttingboard-pan-n1d7-ode-sde-calibration-v1
question: Does the current GR00T N1.7 Flow-SDE behavior policy remain within a 10 percentage-point success-rate equivalence margin of native Flow-ODE before any further optimization?

scope.reason: Five completed updates and three development evaluations are insufficient to infer a learning or generalization trend. Step 5 is included only to diagnose whether the sampler gap changed after the bounded update sequence.

same_project_pi_calibration.decision: The PI0.5 sampler was rejected; later learning was not interpreted until ODE/SDE calibration was repaired.

same_project_gr00t_n1d7_positive_control.interpretation: A previously healthy N1.7 mechanism run did not begin with a large train/eval success-rate disparity.

paired_design.pairing: Every ODE/SDE pair reuses scenario, environment seed, policy seed, and initial Gaussian latent. Only the additional Flow-SDE transition differs.
paired_design.primary_interval: 10,000-sample paired cluster bootstrap over 16 reset seeds
paired_design.secondary_interval: episode-paired bootstrap, reported but not used as the primary admission decision

equivalence_gate.pass: Baseline SDE-minus-ODE point estimate is within [-0.10, 0.10] and the reset-clustered 95% interval is wholly within [-0.10, 0.10].
equivalence_gate.reject: The clustered interval excludes the equivalence region on either side, or the absolute point estimate is at least 0.20.
equivalence_gate.inconclusive: Any result that is neither pass nor reject.

decision_rule.on_pass: The current sampler is admitted. Resume the same one-factor task-isolation recipe without changing optimization settings and evaluate a learning curve through at least update 20 before judging lift.
decision_rule.on_reject: Do not resume optimization. Release GPUs and run a no-optimizer one-factor noise-level calibration while holding K=4 and all reset/policy seeds fixed.
decision_rule.on_inconclusive: Do not resume optimization. Extend only the diagnostic reset panel to 32 environment seeds; do not inspect or consume sealed seeds.
decision_rule.step5_comparisons: Report sampler stability and paired policy differences descriptively. They cannot admit a learning or generalization claim.

observability.weave_disabled_reason: The diagnostic requires W&B run/evidence observability but not trajectory tracing; disabling Weave avoids redundant high-volume traces.
